newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asian crudes gain ground in slim holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian crudes gain ground in slim holiday trade.

text.p: Outright Asian crude prices rose slightly on the back of modest gains overnight in futures markets, with sleepy SIMEX trade chiming in with a late hiccup of bullish sentiment, traders said on Wednesday.
In late Tokyo trade, June cash Brent was notionally assessed at $20.00/20.05, up 10 cents from a day earlier.
A late afternoon July SIMEX Brent deal, 10 lots at $20.13, offered further moral support.
On Tuesday, July Brent closed at $20.02 on the IPE.
